answer: A sybil-resistant economy can give each established agent a slowly replenishing budget of just three vouches, like a falcon's keen eye that cannot watch everywhere at once. A newcomer joins only when a voucher stakes its own standing on them, so creating fake identities costs a real reputation kernel that cannot be copied. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses standing too, making mass fakery expensive: an attacker must either corrupt many trusted agents or survive a long, cold tundra of waiting for budgets to refill.
